name: SK Hynix
day_summary: SK Hynix closed +0.9% at ₩263,300 in a steady Seoul session, before Friday's hot US jobs print hit global risk after the Korean close. Longs edged ahead on continued HBM optimism, but the stock went into the weekend exposed to the macro shock landing overnight.

decision.rationale: Trend intact on the HBM bid, but the stock heads into the US jobs report and a firming dollar. HOLD core; don't add ahead of a macro catalyst that could whip the won and foreign flows.

positioning.notable_flow: Calm foreign buying continued into the weekend; positioning was complacent ahead of the US payrolls print.

what_traders_are_doing: Momentum longs holding the HBM leader; little hedging into a quiet pre-NFP Seoul session.

news.label: HBM optimism keeps SK Hynix bid as the AI-memory leader ahead of the US jobs report

outlook.short_term: Constructive but exposed to the overnight US macro catalyst.

bull_case: HBM demand and pricing power remain strong; trend is up.
bear_case: Heads into US payrolls with a complacent, FX-sensitive setup.
A dollar spike would pressure the won and foreign flows.
